node.title: XR prize flat-nullity effective-core floor
node.statement: For a prize P-A flat-nullity cell with affine rank a and parameters u,v, deleting the persistent roots gives exact-size residual zero sets of size kappa+h with pairwise intersection at most kappa, where kappa=a+u+v. Minimal dense-core private-point counting forces kappa>=ceil((h+1)/(2(L-2))), with L=floor((2R+h-1)/h). The prize floors are 11243370,9629972,2241633; at first open ranks 16,16,14 this forces u+v>=11243354,9629956,2241619. This is a necessary effective-core floor, not a count above it.
